summary: This file is a pure configuration file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines hyperparameters, data pipelines, and training settings for the NeRF-Det 3D object detection model using MMDetection3D conventions.
config_description: NeRF-Det configuration for ScanNet dataset using ResNet-101 backbone with low-resolution images (320x240). Combines neural radiance fields (NeRF) with voxel-based 3D object detection for 18 indoor furniture classes.

key_components.model: nerfdet model with ResNet-101 backbone, FPN neck, FastIndoorImVoxelNeck 3D neck, and ScanNetImVoxelHeadV2 bbox head
key_components.dataset: ScanNetMultiViewDataset with 18 class names (cabinet, bed, chair, sofa, table, door, window, bookshelf, picture, counter, desk, curtain, refrigerator, showercurtain, toilet, sink, bathtub, garbagebin)
key_components.train_pipeline: MultiViewPipeline with 48 images, Resize to 320x240, Normalize, Pad, RandomShiftOrigin augmentation, Collect3D
key_components.test_pipeline: MultiViewPipeline with 101 images, Resize to 320x240, Normalize, Pad, Collect3D
key_components.training: AdamW optimizer (lr=0.0002), 12 epochs with step LR at [8,11], gradient clipping (max_norm=35), 6x dataset repeat

note: This is a configuration-only file with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It cannot be invoked via a CLI module. It is consumed by the MMDetection3D training framework to instantiate models, datasets, and training loops.
